botMessages.title: Assistant messages
botMessages.subtitle: This is how your WhatsApp assistant replies at each point of the conversation. Write them in your own words.

whyVersions.title: Why does each message have 3 or more versions?
whyVersions.body: Your regular customers see these messages many times. If they always read exactly the same text, the conversation feels automated. With 3 or more versions the assistant rotates between them, never repeating the same one twice in a row in a conversation, and sounds like someone on your team. They all say the same thing; only the wording changes.
whyVersions.short: The assistant rotates between versions so it doesn't always repeat the same text. We recommend 3 or more.
